Numbers 16,29,28,27 for sale, all are 4 bed detached houses. 

Welcome to Archersleas, an executive residential Development, that boasts an impeccable array of 4 detached homes, each meticulously planned by visionary architects and constructed by the best of Kilkenny's local craftspeople. Constructed within the walled gardens of the once Rosehill House is a testament to the sophisticated design and thoughtful planning, of the Archersleas Development. Numbers 16,27,28, and 29 remain, 4 Detached properties.
Upon entering Archersleas, you'll be captivated by a one-of-a-kind stone sculptured entrance, an artful gateway that sets the tone for the exceptional living experience that awaits within. The landscape, thoughtfully laid out by skilled architects, complements the natural surroundings while offering residents a breathtaking environment to call home. From tranquil gardens to winding pathways, every inch of the layout is a masterpiece that invites a sense of tranquillity and repose. The 32 homes at Archersleas are a harmonious fusion of modernity and innovation, crafted using cutting-edge building techniques and premium materials. With an unwavering commitment to quality, these residences are designed to stand the test of time, promising not only enduring beauty but also comfort for generations to come. Step inside these elegant homes, and you'll be greeted by spacious interiors that reflect a contemporary yet timeless aesthetic. Quality treble glazed windows invite both silence and natural light, creating a seamless connection with the outdoors. 
Every detail has been carefully considered, from the layout that promotes functionality and flow, to the finishes that exude elegance and luxury. Archersleas isn't just a housing development; it's a place where architectural brilliance, gifted craftspeople, natural splendour, and modern comforts harmonize. 
Whether you're seeking a haven for your family to thrive or an oasis of tranquillity to call your own, Archersleas promises an unparalleled living experience that celebrates past, present and the future. Positioned gracefully within time-honoured stone walls, Archersleas presents a captivating residential haven that evokes the charm of a Georgian walled garden. 
Each distinct house type within this thoughtfully designed development has been christened after the merchant families, that forged the business and success of the city we now reside in. Archer, Shee and Rothe. These names not only pay homage to the rich heritage of Kilkenny City but also serve as a testament to the beauty and serenity that each Archersleas home embodies. Much like the carefully nurtured flowers that once thrived under the sheltered canopy of these historic garden walls, the residences at Archersleas offer a sanctuary of modern comfort and tranquillity.
